description: Query-catalog task. Documents are the 30 queries in metadata/queries/** embedded as 'Name | UserQuestion | Description' (the MJQueryEntityServer composite). Questions and labels written 2026-10-12 by an AI assistant.

documents.text: AIUsageByModel | What is the efficiency, cost, token distribution, and latency for each AI model and vendor? | Per vendor and model (and currency): model-call count, priced/unpriced run counts, own cost, prompt/completion tokens, median and 95th-percentile latency, and cache efficiency percentage.

AIUsageByScope | What is our AI usage, tokens, and spend broken down by primary scope entity and record? | Aggregates AI usage facts by PrimaryScopeEntityID and PrimaryScopeRecordID. Supports optional filtering by scope entity, scope record, and date range.

AIUsageByUser | What is our AI usage, spend, and token volume per user for chargeback attribution? | Aggregates AI usage facts by UserID to support user-level chargeback, attribution, and consumption monitoring.

AIUsageCacheEfficiency | What is our prompt caching hit rate and estimated cost savings across models and prompts? | Prompt cache efficiency per model and prompt (and currency): cache read volume, cache read share, and estimated savings priced at the token rate in effect when each run executed, with a count of runs that could not be rated.

AIUsageDaily | What is our daily AI usage and cost broken down by model, agent, user, and scope? | Primary daily aggregation of AI usage facts. Computes model-call counts, token volumes, latencies (P50/P95), cache reads, and spend (by currency) across all dimensional attributes.

AIUsageErrorRateByModel | What is the error rate and failure frequency for each AI model and vendor? | Per vendor and model: succeeded, failed and abandoned model calls and the resulting error rate, with cancelled and in-flight runs reported separately.

AIUsageHourly | What is our hourly AI usage and cost broken down by model, agent, user, and scope? | Primary hourly aggregation of AI usage facts. Computes model-call counts, token volumes, latencies (P50/P95), cache reads, and spend (by currency) across all dimensional attributes.

AIUsageUnpricedAudit | Which completed AI runs have not been priced and need pricing tiers or investigation? | Surfaces completed AI prompt runs where IsPriced = 0 (parallel parents excluded), newest first, with a diagnostic explanation for why each run was unpriced (unmeasured, or missing pricing tier).
Active Users | Returns all active users with basic profile info. Designed as a reusable building block for composed queries.
Recent Entity Changes | Returns recent record changes grouped by entity name. Accepts a lookbackDays parameter to control the time window.
User Activity Summary | Composed query that joins Active Users with Recent Entity Changes to show each user's recent activity level. Demonstrates the {{query:"..."}} composition syntax.

Entity Records By Tag | Which records of a given entity have a specific tag? | Returns record IDs for a given entity that have a specific tag assigned, with relevance weight. Composable — join on RecordID to the target entity's primary key to enrich with full record data for tag-based filtering and drill-downs.
ExternalChangeDetection_DetectCreations | Detects new records created in an external system by comparing base view rows to existing MJ record changes.
ExternalChangeDetection_DetectUpdates | Detects updated records in an external system by comparing UpdatedAt timestamps.
ExternalChangeDetection_DetectDeletions | Detects deleted records in an external system by identifying MJ record changes with no matching rows in the base view.

GeoBulkLookup_RecordGeoCodesByEntity | Bulk lookup of all RecordGeoCode rows for a given entity. Returns lightweight fields (ID, RecordID, LocationType, SourceFieldHash, Status) for in-memory staleness checking and existence filtering. Used by ScheduledGeocodingAction to eliminate per-record SQL queries during batch geocoding.

GetAgentRunTree | What is the full structure of everything an agent run caused — its steps, any workflows it started, and the runs those workflows spawned? | Returns one row per node of an agent run's complete execution tree: the run, its steps, task graphs those steps submitted, the tasks inside them, and the agent runs those tasks spawned, recursively to a supplied depth cap. Each row carries ParentNodeID/Depth/Sequence so a caller can assemble the tree in memory, plus per-node status, timing, own-cost and own-tokens.

GetArtifactVersionsByID | What are the full artifact version records for a given set of artifact version IDs? | Returns artifact version fields (name, content mode, file ref, content, mime) joined with the parent artifact and artifact type (including ToolLibraryClass) for a supplied list of ArtifactVersionIDs.

GetConversationArtifactsForAgent | What are all the artifacts with their full configurations that were created by a specific agent in this conversation? | Returns all OUTPUT artifacts with their complete version history and configuration data for a conversation, optionally filtered by the agent that created them. Optimized for AI agent API requests that need to build artifact context.

GetConversationArtifactsMap | What artifacts are linked to messages in this conversation? | Returns a lightweight map of all artifacts linked to conversation messages, without loading full content. Optimized for quick display with lazy-loading support.

GetConversationComplete | What are all the messages, agent runs, and artifacts for this conversation? | Returns complete conversation data in a single query: all messages with their related agent runs and artifacts aggregated as JSON. Optimized for fast conversation loading.

GetConversationsForMemoryManager | What conversations have new activity that need to be analyzed for memory extraction? | Returns all conversation data needed for memory extraction in a single query: conversations with new activity, their details with ratings, and linked agent runs for scope inheritance. Optimized to replace 4 separate sequential queries.

ListConversationDetailFeedbackStats | What are the aggregate counts and average for conversation feedback ratings (matching the same filters as the row-level query)? | Aggregate companion for ListConversationDetailFeedback. Returns Total, AvgRating, PositiveCount (>=8), and NegativeCount (<=3) over the same filtered universe (StartDate, EndDate, MinRating, MaxRating, AgentID, SearchText). Used by the Agent Feedback admin page to populate the four stat cards.

ListConversationDetailFeedback | What user ratings and feedback have been left on AI messages? | Lists 1-10 user ratings and free-form feedback on conversation messages, joined with the rater (User), conversation, and agent name. Supports time-range, rating-band, and agent filters.

CalculateRunCost | What is the total cost, token usage, and number of prompts for an AI Agent Run including all its sub-agent runs? | Calculates comprehensive cost metrics for an AI Agent Run, including all nested sub-agent runs. Returns total cost, token usage (input/output), and prompt count by recursively traversing the agent run hierarchy.
Server Installed Version History | Show me a list of versions installed on the server in order of most recent version first

RubricDriftPeriodMeans | How did each agent's rubric criterion mean change between the last two periods? | Mean normalized score per agent, rubric, and criterion for two time windows. Counts only Submitted evaluations that are not self-checks, and only the evaluator's own scores.

Tag Aggregates | What are the aggregate statistics for all tags? | Returns per-tag item count and average relevance weight across all tagged items. Used by the Classify dashboard for taxonomy health metrics without loading individual records.

Tag Distribution For Entity | What tags are most common on records of a given entity? | Aggregates tag counts across all records of a given entity, showing how many records have each tag along with average relevance weight and date range. Composable — use as a subquery or join to analyze topic distribution, category breakdowns, and tag popularity.

Tags For Entity Record | What tags are assigned to a given record? | Returns all active tags assigned to a specific entity record, including tag hierarchy (parent tag) and relevance weight. Composable — join via RecordID to enrich any entity with its tag metadata.
